# German Air Quality Index (Umweltbundesamt Luftqualitätsindex)

Code `de_uba_lqi` · version 2025 risk-based revision (live on UBA API v4) · scale: levels 1–5 · method: step

## Sources

- [UBA, Umwelt und Gesundheit 08/2025: Überarbeitung des Luftqualitätsindex nach den WHO-Leitlinien 2021, Table 5 'Proposal 2 for risk-based AQI'](https://www.umweltbundesamt.de/system/files/medien/11850/publikationen/08_2025_uug.pdf), accessed 2026-10-21
- [Empirical confirmation: 129,519 station-hours of UBA Air Data API v4 /airquality output (2026-01, 2026-07, 2026-10). Every observed band edge matches Proposal 2.](https://luftdaten.umweltbundesamt.de/api/air-data/v4/), accessed 2026-10-21

## Categories

| Level | Category | Colour | Health message |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Very good | `#00A0A0` | Ideal conditions for outdoor activities. |
| 2 | Good | `#5BC8AF` | Enjoy outdoor activities; health effects are unlikely. |
| 3 | Moderate | `#F0E641` | Short-term effects are unlikely, but long-term exposure at this level can harm health. Sensitive people may want to limit strenuous outdoor activity. |
| 4 | Poor | `#FF5050` | Sensitive groups should avoid strenuous outdoor activity. Others should reduce it if symptoms appear. |
| 5 | Very poor | `#960032` | Health effects possible for everyone. Postpone strenuous outdoor activity or move it to a place with better air. |

## Breakpoints

| Pollutant | Averaging | Unit | Very good | Good | Moderate | Poor | Very poor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NO₂ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–10 | 11–30 | 31–60 | 61–100 | > 100 |
| PM10 | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–9 | 10–27 | 28–54 | 55–90 | > 90 |
| PM2.5 | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–5 | 6–15 | 16–30 | 31–50 | > 50 |
| O₃ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–24 | 25–72 | 73–144 | 145–240 | > 240 |
| SO₂ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–10 | 11–30 | 31–60 | 61–100 | > 100 |

## Rules

- Each pollutant's hourly mean, rounded half-up to an integer, is classified into 5 bands with inclusive upper bounds. The index is the worst class (UBA: 'the pollutant with the worst index value determines the overall index').
- An index is formed as soon as one pollutant is available (UBA report, section on application to 2019/2022 data).

## Implementation notes and source discrepancies

- UBA's 2023 documentation (lqi_dokumentation_final_202305.pdf) describes the previous index (NO2 0-20 'very good', PM as a 24-h mean). The API no longer uses it. The live classification matches the 2025 risk-based proposal exactly, including SO2.
- Colours are AirAtlas's palette. UBA's official colours could not be verified because the UBA website was in maintenance mode on 2026-10-21. Health texts are short paraphrases of the 2025 report's Table 6 recommendations.
